description: A lab-local potential open redirect: fully evidenced, but the analyst has not confirmed exploitability, so confidence stays potential.
impact: An attacker could redirect lab users to a phishing page.
proof_of_concept: GET /login?next=https://lab.evil.test/ returns 302 Location: https://lab.evil.test/ after lab login.
remediation: Allowlist redirect targets to lab-local hosts only.
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the redirect to the external lab host
title: Potential open redirect in lab login flow
